name: Pixi Vitamin C Brightening Serum with Ferulic Acid & Probiotics | Antioxidant Glow & Barrier Support
description:
Reveal brighter, healthier-looking skin with this powerful Vitamin C Brightening Serum, formulated to boost radiance while protecting and strengthening your skin. Enriched with pure Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Ferulic Acid, and skin-friendly Probiotics, this advanced formula helps fight dullness, uneven tone, and environmental stress while supporting the skin’s natural moisture barrier. The lightweight, fast-absorbing texture delivers deep hydration with Hyaluronic Acid, Aloe Vera, and Glycerin, leaving skin soft, smooth, and refreshed. A blend of botanical citrus extracts and antioxidants helps promote a luminous glow, while Panthenol and Phospholipids soothe and condition the skin for a healthy, balanced complexion.

Key Features
Vitamin C Brightening Formula for radiant, even-looking skin
Ferulic Acid for powerful antioxidant protection
Probiotics help strengthen the skin’s moisture barrier
Hydrates with Hyaluronic Acid, Aloe Vera & Glycerin
Lightweight, fast-absorbing, non-greasy texture
Helps reduce dullness and improve skin clarity
Supports smoother, healthier-looking skin

Product Type: Vitamin C Brightening Serum
Key Ingredients: Vitamin C, Ferulic Acid, Probiotics, Hyaluronic Acid, Aloe Vera
Skin Concern: Dullness, uneven tone, dryness, environmental damage
Texture: Lightweight liquid serum
